{{Quote|When I was nearly captured in the Lorn system some time ago, it was the Sandwind operatives who helped me find the Vuzsa safehouse and hole up until Moff Murquan gave up on me&hellip;|Tiree, personal addendum to Rebel Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex file on the "Jundland Banshee"|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
The '''Lorn system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Murquan]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] nearly captured the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Tay Vanis|Tiree]] in the Lorn [[Star system/Legends|system]]. At that point, the Alliance's [[Sandwind group]], based out of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in<ref name="AIR" /> the neighboring<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], helped Tiree locate the Rebel [[Vuzsa safehouse|safehouse]] at<ref name="AIR" /> the Arkanis [[Sector/Legends|sector]] world<ref name="TEA" /> [[Vuzsa/Legends|Vuzsa]], allowing him to wait out until the Imperials stopped looking for him. Tiree eventually relayed the incident in a personal addendum to the Rebel [[Task Force on Alliance Security]]'s [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on the rogue [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] known as the "[[Jundland Banshee]]."<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lorn system was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed it in grid square R-17.<ref name="TEA" />
